from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
import re, hashlib
out=Path.home()/"agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p1-s22-20260912"
def cards(path):
    root=ET.parse(path).getroot(); rows=[]
    for n in root.iter():
        if n.attrib.get('clickable')!='true': continue
        m=re.fullmatch(r'\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]',n.attrib.get('bounds',''))
        if not m: continue
        x1,y1,x2,y2=map(int,m.groups()); w=x2-x1; h=y2-y1
        if w>=650 and 70<=h<=400 and y1>=180 and y2<=2300:
            rows.append((x1,y1,x2,y2,h))
    return sorted(rows,key=lambda x:(x[1],x[0]))
